record.title: EXPLORE manufacturing throughput
record.body: Current EXPLORE run manufactured 53 attributed semantic commits in ggen-marketplace before Project post-state writes. All 53 carry Schedule-Run and Schedule-Cell trailers. Exact repository head 5110ec7dbf9b1bac32e5e9dd444dda8e403eb0a6. Previous canonical throughput observation was 54 commits over 8.2667 active minutes (~391.94 commits/hour) for SELECT_DEVELOP; cross-cell comparison is observational, not causal equivalence.
